120: Come and see! Behold it is written: If there be found a corpse, etc. (Deuteronomy 21:1). Come and see! The souls of all the people of the world depart on account of the Angel of Death. But if you say that this man's soul departed on account of the Angel of Death, it is not so! Rather, the one who killed him made his soul depart before it was the Angel of Death's time to have dominion over it.
